title: Human attestation for one criterion
description: ai-factory/evidence/<delivery_id>/<AC|QC><n>-attest.json. Written only by `contracts.js attest`. It counts toward a completion report only when completion.allow_attestation is true and no automated check for the criterion failed.

source.description: Where the human evidence lives, e.g. a ticket comment or a document.

inputs.description: The content the attestation was made against; a later edit makes it stale.
